items.name: Manthara Fancy Dress
items.body: A Manthara fancy dress for Ramleela and school Ramayan plays: the scheming old maid of Queen Kaikeyi, the character who sets Ram's vanvas in motion. The set is a black lehenga banded in red, orange, yellow and blue ribbon with silver criss-cross trim, and a short black blouse with a silver yoke and a red zigzag waistband. In the photo it is finished with a grey bun wig, a long pearl mala and a wooden walking stick, so a child can play the bent, grumbling Manthara (also spelt Manthra) that every audience recognises. It is a strong character role for a girl who wants something other than Sita, and it suits Dussehra stage plays and mythology fancy dress competitions alike. Tell us your child's age when you book and we will set aside the right size.

items.body: A Raja Dashrath costume for kids, made for the Ayodhya court scenes of the Ramleela. The king wears a cream and gold armour top worked with blue paisley stones, red beads and gold fringe at the shoulders, over rani pink bandhani sleeves and a gold waist belt. Pink dhoti pants with gold borders and a tall gold mukut with red and white stones complete the royal look, and in the photo he carries a gold sword and a moustache. It is the right dress for the scenes where Dashrath crowns Ram, grants Kaikeyi her boons and sends his son to the forest, and it works for any Indian king role in a school play or fancy dress competition. Tell us your child's age when you book and we will set aside the right size.

items.name: Mustard Peacock Print Dandiya Lehenga
items.body: A mustard yellow dandiya lehenga for women in a kalamkari-style print: peacocks, flowering vines and birds cover the full flared skirt, which ends in a broad border of sage green medallions, maroon zigzag bands and a black hem. The sleeveless choli carries the same print with a bordered neckline, and the sage green dupatta is printed with florals and peacocks of its own, edged in maroon and finished with green tassels. Earthy rather than neon, it stands out on a dandiya night full of red and pink, and the flare is wide enough to turn well in garba. Sized for women and older teens; tell us your measurements when you book and we will set one aside.
